## Smallest detected magnitude

### disable-frame-batching

One or more contributing runs measured a module set narrower than the runner's own default. Gate baseline cells are keyed per (benchmark, metric), so the observing cell's own lookup is unaffected by which other modules ran, and a narrowed run is therefore admissible evidence for the cell it observes. It is not a like-for-like replica of the full-module population runs and must not be read as one.
